onboard.frontierhunts.step.2.p1: You have a Field Recurve Bow and only 3 arrows, so make more. Primitive Arrows need flint, a stick and a feather laid corner to corner (straight down makes vanilla arrows). Hunting Arrows need an iron nugget, a stick and a feather, top to bottom. Both give 4 at a time.
onboard.frontierhunts.task.arrows.card: Primitive Arrows: flint, stick, feather (corner to corner). Hunting Arrows: nugget, stick, feather.
onboard.frontierhunts.task.arrows.how: Craft Primitive Arrows (flint, stick, feather, corner to corner) or Hunting Arrows (iron nugget, stick, feather).
onboard.frontierhunts.task.rifle.how: Craft a Ridgeline Rifle (an iron block barrel, iron, a tripwire-hook trigger and a wooden stock), then practise on The Range.
item.frontierhunts.tanned_fur.note: Clothing Table: fur hats, mittens, linings, mukluks.
